cats.name: Stations & crew
cats.desc: A space station or a vehicle visiting one.

cats.name: Starlink
cats.desc: Part of SpaceX's Starlink network, which beams broadband internet to homes, ships, planes and remote areas. Newer Starlinks also relay data to each other by laser.

cats.name: Other broadband
cats.desc: Part of a large low-orbit constellation that provides broadband internet.

cats.name: Communications
cats.desc: A communications satellite relaying TV, internet, phone or data signals.

cats.name: Navigation
cats.desc: A navigation satellite broadcasting timing signals that receivers use to work out their position.

cats.name: Weather
cats.desc: A weather satellite that images clouds and measures the atmosphere for forecasts.

cats.name: Earth imaging
cats.desc: An Earth-observation satellite that photographs or scans the surface for mapping, farming, disasters or intelligence.

cats.name: Science & tech
cats.desc: A science or technology mission: a telescope, a research satellite or a test of new spacecraft hardware.

cats.name: Military
cats.desc: A military or government security satellite. Details of its mission are usually not public.

cats.name: Other
cats.desc: Its mission details aren't in the public catalog.
